_description: Phase 4 capability fixture: an AREA key light offset well away from the subject (aim_at defaults to origin), a SPOT light with a narrow cone, and lighting_rig fallback is exercised separately by omitting lighting[] entirely in a copy of this fixture -- see fixtures/README.md. Confirmed via direct before/after render: without aim_at, an offset light like OffsetKey only illuminates the ground below itself and leaves the subject nearly flat-lit by ambient alone.
